## Summary

What does this PR change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (add a regression test in `tests/`)
- [ ] New feature (new manifold method / retraction / hyperparameter)

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check rmona/ tests/ examples/` passes

violation checks, etc.).
